reference_french: En effet, Salomon, fils de David, épousa 700 femmes et 80 concubines. Mais aucune d’entre elles n’obtint de fils. En effet, le Seigneur Très-Haut ne voulait pas que la postérité de Canaan s’unît avec le peuple élu, duquel s’incarnerait Notre-Seigneur et Notre-Sauveur Jésus-Christ. (Or), toutes les femmes de Salomon étaient de la postérité de Canaan.
score_facts: Solomon is son of David and has many wives/concubines.
None of these women bears him a son.
The Most High does not want Canaanite descent mixed with the chosen people.
Jesus Christ becomes incarnate from the chosen people.
Solomon’s women are of Canaanite descent.
review_only: The machine transcription does not clearly support the French distinction of 700 wives plus 80 concubines. Do not score that numerical distinction.

Lorsqu’on eut jeté Moïse dans le fleuve, Sâfir, fille de Pharaon, le prit, et l’apporta dans sa maison.
score_facts: Moses is identified as a prophet of God.
Levi goes to Egypt with his father.
Moses and other named descendants are born there.
Joshua is son of Nun/Nawé.
Moses is put in the river.
Pharaoh’s daughter Safir takes Moses and brings him to her house.
review_only: Te‘mrân versus the machine transcription’s name is a transliteration/reading question; do not penalise the spelling.

reference_french: Après que Moïse fut mort, Josué, fils de Nawé, jugea le peuple pendant 31 ans. Après lui, l’impie Kuesâ les jugea pendant 8 ans. Après lui, Hatonyâl, fils de Qénéz, frère de Caleb, les jugea pendant 50 ans. Ensuite, les enfants d’Israël furent asservis à Églon, roi de Moab, pendant 18 ans. Puis le Seigneur les délivra. Ensuite, Nâ’od, fils de Gérâ, les jugea pendant 80 ans. C’est (pendant) la 27e année de la judicature de Nâ’od que s’écoula l’an 4000 de la création.
score_facts: Moses dies before Joshua son of Nun judges the people.
A wicked ruler follows Joshua and rules eight years.
Othniel/Hatonyâl is son of Kenaz/Qénéz and related as brother to Caleb.
Israel becomes subject to Eglon, king of Moab.
God delivers Israel from that ruler.
Ehud/Na’od is son of Gera and rules eighty years.
The narrative connects Ehud’s judgeship with year 4000 from creation.
review_only: Joshua 31 versus raw transcription 24; Othniel 50 versus 10; Eglon 18 versus108; Ehud anniversary27 versus17 are not scored. These could be transcription errors or witness differences.
The omitted given name Joshua in one clause is partly recoverable from son of Nun; allow an explicit supplied Joshua.

Gédéon les jugea pendant… ans. Après lui, Abimélec les jugea pendant 30 ans. Après lui, Tolâ, fils de Fouha, les jugea pendant 23 ans, et les rendit forts. Après lui, Iyâ’ér de Galaad jugea Israël pendant 22 ans.
score_facts: Deborah and Barak judge for forty years.
The people of Midian enslave Israel for seven years.
God delivers Israel through Gideon.
Abimelech rules after Gideon.
Tola is son of Puah/Fouha and rules twenty-three years.
A Gileadite ruler follows Tola and rules Israel.
review_only: Gideon’s years are a gap in the French.
Abimelech30 versus3 and Jair22 versus12 are not scored.
French makes Tola strengthen them; raw transcription reads a standing/arising phrase. Treat as review-only.

Jephté les jugea pendant 7 ans. Après lui, Hésébon les jugea pendant 7 ans. Après lui, Élômou, (de la tribu) de Zabulon, les jugea pendant 10 ans. Après lui, Lâbon les jugea pendant 8 ans. score_facts: God delivers Israel and Jephthah rules for seven years.
Hesebon/Ibzan follows and rules seven years.
Philistines enslave Israel for forty years.
Elon/Elomou is a Zebulunite ruler.
God delivers Israel through mighty Samson.
Samson rules/judges the people.
review_only: The French contains Jephthah’s daughter sacrifice and Labon, absent from this raw transcript; those reference-only clauses are not scored.
Order of Elon and Philistine oppression differs; do not score the ordering.
Elon10 versus40 and Samson20 versus18 are not scored.
The French opening Philistine18-year clause precedes the chosen Ge’ez span; do not score its omission.
